description: A 2D graphic illustrative art style characterized by clean geometric silhouettes, uniform dark outlines, and a desaturated, atmospheric color palette centered around earthy wood tones, warm terracottas, and deep nocturnal blues. Compositions emphasize quiet emotional depth and dramatic cinematic lighting through high-contrast cast moonlight beams, warm glowing lantern apertures, and soft low-lying fog contrasting against pitch-dark interiors.

render.outline: all inner lines, uniform medium weight
render.lighting: High-contrast atmospheric lighting utilizing volumetric moonlight shafts, soft radial lantern glows, warm window illumination, and subtle warm rim highlights on dark silhouettes.

character.headToBody: 1:2.5 to 1:3 for children, 1:3.5 to 1:4 for adults
character.headShape: Broad rounded ovals with gentle contours and flat chins
character.eyes: Minimalist closed downward-curving line arcs conveying solemnity or repose, without rendered irises or eye whites
character.brows: Thin, expressive arched or slanted black stroke lines placed high above the eyes
character.mouth: Simple horizontal line or small dark-filled rounded oval, without lip contouring
character.nose: Single short vertical stroke marking the nose bridge, highly simplified
character.ears: Small rounded C-shapes level with the eye line; adult characters feature round golden stud earrings #d4af37
character.hair: Solid graphic masses in dark charcoal #211f20 with clean exterior silhouettes, rendered as neat bowl-cut bangs or combed-back traditional buns with thin headbands
character.arms: Simplified tubular forms resting naturally against the torso
character.hands: Minimalist mittens or concealed silhouettes with minimal finger delineation
character.body: Soft trapezoidal and flared bell-shaped torso silhouettes with sloping shoulders
character.clothing: Functional traditional and casual attire in flat color blocks, such as terracotta buttoned tunics #94442b with patch pockets #7c3722 and nautical horizontal striped crewnecks in cobalt #3b6e9a and white #ffffff
character.skin: Fair to warm beige skin tone #f4c29e with warm muted shadow tone #cf9b7c, with circular soft pink blush #e99595 on youth
character.expressions: Melancholic, serene, and introspective, indicated by downward angled eyebrows, closed eye arcs, and subtle curved age lines near the mouth

kit.animals: Stylized geometric black cats with spherical heads #1e1f26, pointed triangular ears with mauve-pink interior accents #5b3e4e, bright golden-yellow oval or almond eyes #fbc02d with dark pupil slits, thin white horizontal whisker lines, smooth curving tails, and contrasting solid white front paws #ffffff

background.layers: Silhouetted foreground elements, midground character/architectural plane, and atmospheric background separated by mist layers or window frames
background.detail: Moderate architectural detailing focusing on vertical wooden planks, simple linear shelves, barred windows, and layered mountain silhouettes
background.props: Vernacular domestic and architectural objects such as ceramic bowls, hanging globe lanterns #fdf4db, wooden benches, and framed shop fascia boards

kit.fx: Diagonal linear rain dashes, soft ground-level fog bands #6a737d, trapezoidal volumetric moonlight beams, and soft circular ambient glow halos
kit.typography: Clean uppercase Vietnamese signage in dark red-brown #701a14 with bold sans-serif lettering, centered on parchment-cream rectangular boards #f3ebd7 with dark double borders
kit.camera: Static, theatrical straight-on eye-level framing with centered symmetrical compositions and natural architectural framing via doors and windows

images.name: style-reference-1
images.details: Stylized black cat seated in three-quarter profile facing forward against a dark brown background. The cat features a circular head #1e1f26, pointed triangular ears with mauve inner shading #5b3e4e, large round golden-yellow eyes #fbc02d with dark vertical slits, three thin white whisker strokes on each side, a teardrop-shaped body #1e1f26, an upward curving tail, and a solid white vertical left paw #ffffff. Warm amber rim lighting #c89665 accents the right side of the head and chest. All forms have solid dark outlines #121212. The background is a soft radial gradient glowing from warm amber-brown #4a2c14 in the center out to near-black #0c0704 at the edges.

images.name: style-reference-2
images.details: Interior shot of two stylized human characters against a dark wooden plank wall #22160f. The adult figure on the left has an oval head #f4c29e, smooth charcoal hair #211f20 pulled into a round bun, gold stud earrings #d4af37, downward-curved line eyes, arched brows, a short vertical nose line, and a small line mouth with age creases. She wears a rust-brown flared tunic #94442b with three dark buttons #522416 and a square pocket #7c3722 over dark trousers #2b2e3a. To her right, a young boy with a rounded head #f6cbb3 features dark bowl-cut hair #211f20, closed curved eye lines, a small open oval mouth #592e2e, soft pink circular blush #e99595, and a half-shadow tone #d3a38d across his face. He wears a blue and white striped shirt #3b6e9a and #ffffff. The background features a barred window revealing a moonlit sky #101c36, a wooden cot #5c4028, and a shelf with dark ceramic bowls #28303d.

images.name: style-reference-3
images.details: Straight-on exterior view of a wooden apothecary building at night. The main structure has vertical timber siding in warm ochre-brown #8e5f38, dark double sliding central doors #573b26, and two square windows glowing with warm amber interior light #f5b847. A hanging globe lantern #fdf4db is suspended above the door. A rectangular illuminated sign above the corrugated roof #606870 displays uppercase red-brown text #701a14 reading THUOC BAC - THUOC NAM HANH LAM on a cream board #f3ebd7. An auxiliary wooden shed #6b492d with an open dark entry sits on the right. Soft grey fog bands #6a737d drift across the base, set against silhouetted dark mountain peaks #323f4f under a slate-blue gradient night sky #435368 to #263342.

images.name: style-reference-4
images.details: Interior medium composition framed by a large multi-pane dark wood window frame #3d2618. A stylized black cat #1e1f26 with triangular ears #5b3e4e, yellow slit eyes #e7b416, white whiskers, and a white front paw #ffffff sits on a brown sill #5c3d28 in profile. Outside the window, a glowing circular white full moon #e2efff illuminates a dark indigo night sky #1e3250 with silhouetted mountain ridges #162438 and diagonal falling rain streaks #839fb5. Inside the dark room #16110d, a wide diagonal trapezoid of blue-grey volumetric moonlight #2b3547 is projected across the vertical wood plank floorboards.
